name: AgentDraw — NEON Style (Template)
description: Drawn in light. Glowing lines on midnight paper — the night-shift style. This is the NEON style template for AgentDraw on BNB Chain. Every AgentDraw NFT is drawn live by an AI agent at mint; the final per-token metadata carries that token's own artwork and number. This template defines the NEON style. Supply 1,444 = 1,222 Free (Binance Agent ID holders) + 222 Paid at 0.0012 BNB.
